name: PII & Secret Redactor
blurb: personal data and secrets found in text and replaced with placeholders before it goes to a model, with a map to put them back
intro: Finds personal data and secrets in text, logs or code with documented patterns and checksums (Luhn, IBAN mod-97, TC Kimlik No, E.164, vendor key prefixes, Shannon entropy) and replaces them with placeholders; a map puts the values back into the model's answer. Runs locally: nothing is sent anywhere.

inputs.help: One per line: exact values not to redact (clicking a highlight does this).

inputs.label: Also redact
inputs.help: One per line: strings to redact wherever they appear (selecting text on the page does this).

inputs.label: Entropy threshold
inputs.help: For unlabelled tokens of 20+ characters with letters and digits; random base64 is ~5-6, English words ~3-4.

examples.title: Restore a model answer written against a redacted Stripe traceback

input.text:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/app/billing/sync.py", line 88, in push_invoice
    resp = client.post(url, json=payload, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices

payload = {"customer_email": "j.keller@example.de", "iban": "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00", "amount": 12900}
token = "sk_test_EXAMPLE0EXAMPLE0EXAMPLE0EXAMPLE"
env: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_EXAMPLE0EXAMPLE0EXAMPLE0EXAMPLE
host 172.16.4.21 -> 52.94.236.248
input.answer:
The 401 comes from <API_KEY_1>: it is a test-mode key, but the webhook secret <PASSWORD_1> and the invoice belong to the live account.
1. Rotate <API_KEY_1> (it was printed in the traceback).
2. Retry the invoice for <EMAIL_1>; the IBAN <IBAN_1> is fine.
3. Tell <EMAIL_2> once the retry succeeds.

usage: Give the text, optionally a list of names, the placeholder style (tag, bracket, redacted, hash), types to leave (off) and exact values to keep or extra strings to redact. It returns the redacted text, a findings table with masked values, counts per type, and the placeholder->value map (sensitive: keep it local). With mode=restore and the model's answer it returns the answer with the real values put back and flags placeholders the map does not know. Use it before pasting logs, tickets or configs into a model.
sources: ISO/IEC 7812-1 (Luhn check digit, issuer identification numbers)
ISO 13616-1 IBAN (mod 97-10 per ISO 7064) and the SWIFT IBAN Registry lengths
T.C. kimlik numarası check-digit algorithm (NVİ, as published)
ITU-T E.164 numbering; BTK national numbering plan (TR 05xx mobile, 0[2-4]xx landline)
RFC 4291 §2.2 IPv6 text form; RFC 1918 / RFC 5737 address ranges; RFC 3986 §3.2.1 userinfo; RFC 7519 JWT; RFC 7468 PEM
Vendor key formats as documented by AWS (AKIA/ASIA access key IDs), GitHub (token prefixes), Slack, Stripe, Google, Anthropic, OpenAI and OpenRouter
Shannon entropy H = -Σ p log2 p over the token's characters; FNV-1a 32-bit (Fowler-Noll-Vo) for hash placeholders
